step_pairs.previous_step_result: Source code analysis revealed two critical flaws: 1) prctl(PR_SET_DUMPABLE, 1) called before fork operations makes all processes traceable, not just target process 2) jailsfd file descriptor pointing to parent jail directory is not closed in processes PID 1 and 3, only closed in PID 2, enabling file descriptor access via /proc/1/fd/3/ to read files outside chroot jail
